te: Meeting 20/2569 · Subcommittee on the Development of the State Administration System and Public Sector Personnel (former subcommittee)
Approach set for a new study: making government services more efficient
se: The meeting considered an approach for studying how to make government services more efficient to raise competitiveness, covering the move to a digital civil service, value for money in government work, and better services to the public in line with the facilitation law. The new subcommittee continues this study from July 2026.
it: Approach to the study on improving the efficiency of public services to raise competitiveness

te: Land matters in Chon Buri Province: an explanation of the aerial photographs was requested, and the Mae Hong Son matter was sent to the province for consideration
se: The meeting was of the view that the Royal Thai Survey Department should prepare an official explanation of its interpretation of the aerial photographs, so that the facts are decided carefully and fairly for all sides, and sent the complaint about a request to use state land for a dialysis centre in Mae Hong Son Province to the Governor of Mae Hong Son.
it: Petition about the issuing of a title deed for a plot of land in Phanat Nikhom District, Chon Buri Province
Petition about delays in a request to use state land in Mae Hong Son Province to set up a haemodialysis centre

te: Follow-up on the road over the water-supply canal, a land matter in Chon Buri Province, and a dispute between private parties closed
se: The meeting was of the view that the Office of the Permanent Secretary to the Prime Minister's Office, the Department of Highways, the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration and the Metropolitan Waterworks Authority should be invited to clarify the road over the water-supply canal; that the Department of Lands and the Royal Thai Survey Department should be invited to give information on the land matter in Chon Buri Province; and closed a complaint about an inheritance because it is a dispute between private parties.
it: Request to follow up the royally initiated project for the road over the water-supply canal
Petition about the issuing of a title deed for a plot of land in Phanat Nikhom District, Chon Buri Province
Petition about a dispute over the division of an inheritance

te: Land matters in Khon Kaen Province, and follow-up on the road project over the waterworks canal
se: The meeting was of the view that the Khon Kaen Provincial Land Office, Khon Kaen City Municipality and the complainant should meet to re-survey the boundaries of the plot, and took up a request to follow up the royally initiated project for the road over the water-supply canal, for which the complainant will be invited to give more information.
it: Petition about the boundary survey of a plot of land in Khon Kaen City Municipality
Request to follow up the royally initiated project for the road over the water-supply canal

te: A representative of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel (OTEP) explains the textbook e-bidding, and the meeting notes the kratom working group
se: A representative of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel (OTEP) explained the bidding. The meeting was of the view that the organisation should consult the Comptroller General's Department in writing, followed up a land matter in Khon Kaen City Municipality by inviting the Department of Lands and the municipality to clarify, and noted Committee Order No. 30/2569 setting up a working group to study the enforcement of the Kratom Act B.E. 2565 (2022) in Bangkok.
it: Petition about the electronic price bidding (e-bidding) for printing textbooks for academic year 2026 by the trading organisation of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel
Petition about the boundary survey of a plot of land in Khon Kaen City Municipality
Committee Order No. 30/2569 setting up a working group to study the enforcement of the Kratom Act B.E. 2565 (2022) in Bangkok
